messages.subject: Project Mosaic - execution versions and completion on 12 September
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Execution versions attached: the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement, the Investor Rights Agreement, and the board resolutions for the company. These reflect everything agreed - 75% liability cap, 12-month claims survival, IP warranties qualified by the founder's awareness with the deemed-knowledge wording, 18-month non-compete and non-solicitation, de minimis 20% / Threshold GBP 80,000, and the MAC condition at 3.1.7 retained.

We'd like to complete on Thursday 12 September. Please arrange for the company and Sophie to execute, for the sole director to sign the board resolutions, and confirm the disclosure letter is final. New Articles and the shareholder written resolutions are in the bible.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: All, Project Mosaic has completed. The SPA, Investor Rights Agreement and board resolutions were exe
messages.subject: RE: Project Mosaic - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Project Mosaic has completed. The SPA, Investor Rights Agreement and board resolutions were executed this morning and the GBP 4,000,000 subscription has been funded against the issue of 2,000,000 Series A preference shares at GBP 2.00, leaving Crestview at c.22.2% fully diluted. Executed SPA attached for the file.

For the record, the executed positions are: warrantor liability cap 75% of the Investment Amount; claims survival 12 months; IP warranties qualified by the founder's awareness (with deemed-knowledge wording); founder non-compete and non-solicitation 18 months; de minimis 20% of the Threshold; Threshold GBP 80,000; and a Material Adverse Change condition at clause 3.1.7.

Thanks all for a quick and constructive close.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
